ReplaceConfiguration.name: Replace Configuration
ReplaceConfiguration.definition: True if the whole configuration related to the terminal manager has to be replaced by the configuration included in the message content.| Usage: When absent, default value is False.

TMSProtocolParameters.name: TMS Protocol Parameters
TMSProtocolParameters.definition: Configuration parameters of the TMS protocol between a POI and a terminal manager.

AcquirerProtocolParameters.name: Acquirer Protocol Parameters
AcquirerProtocolParameters.definition: Acceptor parameters dedicated to an acquirer protocol.

ServiceProviderParameters.name: Service Provider Parameters
ServiceProviderParameters.definition: Acceptor parameters dedicated to a service provider.

MerchantParameters.name: Merchant Parameters
MerchantParameters.definition: Acceptor parameters dedicated to the merchant.

TerminalParameters.name: Terminal Parameters
TerminalParameters.definition: Manufacturer configuration parameters of the point of interaction.

ApplicationParameters.name: Application Parameters
ApplicationParameters.definition: Acceptor parameters dedicated to a payment application of the point of interaction.

HostCommunicationParameters.name: Host Communication Parameters
HostCommunicationParameters.definition: Acceptor parameters dedicated to the communication with an acquirer host or a terminal manager host.

SecurityParameters.name: Security Parameters
SecurityParameters.definition: Point of interaction parameters related to the security of software application and application protocol.

SaleToPOIParameters.name: Sale To POI Parameters
SaleToPOIParameters.definition: Parameters dedicated to protocols between a sale system and the POI.

TerminalPackage.name: Terminal Package
TerminalPackage.definition: Group of software packages to transfer to a group of POIComponent of the POI System.

OneElementPresenceRule.definition: At least one of these subelements mut be present.
